🧹 Data Cleaning
Upload Master File 1 — validates, flags errors row-by-row, and outputs cleaned data with full error remarks
ℹ️
How it works: Upload your raw dealer data file. The tool reads all columns, runs all validation checks, and produces a download with the original data + individual error flag columns + one combined ERROR SUMMARY column at the end. Clean rows have blank error columns. Error rows show exactly what is wrong.
📂
Upload Master File 1 — Raw Dealer Data
Supports .xlsx, .xls, .csv · Click or drag & drop

🚨
Validation Checks — Select to Apply
✓
Check 01
Mandatory Column — Blank Check
Flags blank values in: Booking Number, Booking Date, Delivery Date, Dealership, Customer Name, Model, SC Name, SC Number, Finance Type, Insurance Type, Pin Code, First receipt date. Also flags missing mandatory columns in the uploaded file.
MANDATORYBLANK CHECK
✓
Check 02
Contact Number Validation
Must be exactly 10 numeric digits. Flags: blank, less/more than 10 digits, non-numeric characters, all-same digits (e.g. 9999999999, 0000000000).
CONTACT10 DIGITS
✓
Check 03
Aadhar Number Validation
Must be exactly 12 numeric digits. Flags: blank, less/more than 12 digits, non-numeric, all-same digits, all zeros (000000000000).
AADHAR12 DIGITS
✓
Check 04
PAN Number Validation
Must match format ABCDE1234F — 5 uppercase letters, 4 digits, 1 uppercase letter. Flags: blank, wrong length, wrong format, lowercase entries.
PANFORMAT CHECK
✓
Check 05
SC Number Validation
Must be exactly 10 numeric digits. Flags: blank, less/more than 10 digits, non-numeric, all-same digits (0000000000, 1111111111 etc.).
SC NUMBER10 DIGITS
✓
Check 06
Sent Back Options — OOS / MR Breach Check
If Deal Type = "Out of Scope", "Management Referral", or "OEM Referral", the Sent Back Options column cannot have the exact value "Breach". Only the word "Breach" is flagged — "No Breach" and other values are not flagged.
BREACHOOS · MR
✓
Check 07
Conditional Mandatory — Insurance Fields
If Insurance Type = "Inhouse": Insurance Amount, Insurance Company Name and Agent Code cannot be blank. Flags each missing field separately.
INSURANCECONDITIONAL
✓
Check 08
Conditional Mandatory — Bank Name
If Finance Type is not "Outright" or "Outright Purchase", Bank Name cannot be blank. Flags cases where a financed deal has no bank name recorded.
FINANCECONDITIONAL
✓
Check 09
Conditional Mandatory — GST for Corporate
If Type of Customer = "Corporate", GST field cannot be blank. Flags all corporate customers with missing GST number.
GSTCORPORATE
✓
Check 10
Duplicate Contact No — Same Dealership, Same Model
Identifies cases where the same Contact No appears more than once within the same Dealership with the same Model name. Flags all rows in such groups with the duplicate pair count and first occurrence booking number.
DUPLICATESAME MODELSAME DEALER
✓
Check 11
Duplicate Contact No — Same Dealership, Different Model
Identifies cases where the same Contact No appears more than once at the same Dealership but with different Model names. Flags all rows in such groups with duplicate count and model names involved.
DUPLICATEDIFF MODELSAME DEALER
✓
Check 12
Invalid Contact Number
Flags all rows where Contact No is invalid: not exactly 10 digits, contains non-numeric characters, all same digits (e.g. 9999999999), or starts with 0. Separate from Check 02 — this flags the contact as invalid regardless of other fields, and also marks if the invalid number appears more than once (repeat invalid).
INVALIDCONTACT NOREPEAT INVALID
✓
Check 13
Ex Showroom — Standard vs Actual Variance
Compares "Ex Showroom - Standard Amount" with "Ex Showroom - Actual Amount". If any difference exists between the two, the row is flagged with both amounts and the variance. Helps detect unauthorised pricing deviations at the ex-showroom level.
EX SHOWROOMVARIANCESTD vs ACTUAL
✓
Check 14
Actual Head Filled — Standard Head Blank
Scans all pairs of "[Head] - Standard Amount" and "[Head] - Actual Amount" columns. If any Actual Amount is filled (> 0) but the corresponding Standard Amount is blank or zero, the row is flagged with the head name and actual value. Catches data entry gaps where actuals are recorded without a standard benchmark.
ACTUAL HEADSSTANDARD BLANKMISSING STANDARD
✓ Now skips BH / Bharat / Self:By Customer registration · Other heads ignore differences ≤ ₹100 · TCS & FASTag use the configurable Min/Max ranges below
✓
Check 10b
Duplicate Chassis No — Same Dealership
Flags rows where the same New Car Chassis No. (rightmost 8 chars, normalised) appears more than once at the same dealership. Catches double-entry or system duplication errors for the same vehicle.
CHASSISDUPLICATESAME DEALER
✓
Check 15
New Car Chassis No. — Format & Model Year Validation
Column: "New Car Chasiss No." — Mahindra: min 8 chars, rightmost 8; first char R→2024 / S→2025 / T→2026. MG brand (model contains "MG"): min 9 chars, rightmost 9; first digit 8→2025 / 9→2026. Flags short chassis, wrong R/S/T or 8/9, and model year mismatches.
CHASSISR/S/TMODEL YEAR
✓
Check 16
Delivery Date Before Booking Date
Flags any row where Delivery Date is earlier than Booking Date — a logically impossible sequence indicating a data entry error or date swap.
DATE ERRORBOOKINGDELIVERY
✓
Check 17
OOS "Out of Territory" — Registration State Must Differ from Dealership State
When "Out of Scope" reason = "Out of Territory", the Registration State must differ from Dealership State. If they match, the Out of Territory claim is invalid. Reads column "Dealership state" from your file (also tries "State" / "Location" as fallback if column not found).
OOSTERRITORYSTATE CHECK
✓
Check 18
Duplicate Agent Code — Self Insurance
For rows where Insurance Type = "Self", flags every row where the same Agent Code appears more than once in the file — across all dealerships. Detects one agent code linked to multiple self-insurance rows, which may indicate manipulation or data entry error.
AGENT CODESELF INSURANCEDUPLICATE
✓
Check 19
Duplicate Agent Code — Self Insurance, Same Dealership
For rows where Insurance Type = "Self", flags every row where the same Agent Code is used on more than one Self-insurance entry within the same Dealership. Narrower than Check 18 — focuses on within-dealer recycling of the same agent code on Self deals, a stronger signal of manipulation than a file-wide duplicate.
AGENT CODESELF INSURANCESAME DEALER
✓
Check 20
Same Agent Code — BOTH Self AND In-House, Same Dealership
Flags rows where the same Agent Code is used on both a "Self" and an "In-House" insurance entry within the same Dealership. Indicates an agent code straddling both insurance roles at one dealer — potential mis-tagging or routing of in-house business as self. Both the Self rows and the In-House rows in the matching group are flagged.
AGENT CODESELF + IN-HOUSESAME DEALER
✓
Report A
Pendency Sheet — TL Email wise (Sent Back Options = "Pending")
Extracts all rows where "Sent Back Options" = "Pending" and produces a TL Email-wise summary sheet. Shows count of pending cases per TL with full booking details. Download includes a summary table followed by a drill-down of all pending rows grouped by TL Email.
PENDENCYTL EMAIL WISEEXTRA SHEET
✓
Report B
Breach Sheet — TL Email wise (Sent Back Options = "Breach")
Extracts all rows where "Sent Back Options" = "Breach" (irrespective of Deal Type) and produces a TL Email-wise summary sheet. Shows count of breach cases per TL with full booking details. Useful for reviewing which TL has the most breach cases flagged by the dealer.
BREACHTL EMAIL WISEEXTRA SHEET
✓
Report C
TL Review — Last 7 Days (TL Review Date wise)
Filters all rows where "TL Review Date" falls within the last 7 days from today's date. Groups results TL Email wise showing review date, booking details and review status. Helps track which TLs have been reviewing and which are delayed in their review activity.
TL REVIEWLAST 7 DAYSEXTRA SHEET
✓
Report D
Ex Showroom — Actual Amount Range (Min / Max), Model & Variant wise · Individual customers only
For column "Ex Showroom - Actual Amount", computes Min, Max, Range (Max − Min), Mean and Count grouped first by Model, then by Model Variant. Filtered to rows where Type of Customer = "Individual" (so Corporate / CSD / Leasing prices don't distort the retail-pricing band). Excludes blank and zero values. Sorted by Range (descending) to surface the biggest outliers first — useful for spotting data-entry errors or unauthorised price entries within a single Model.
EX SHOWROOMMODEL WISEVARIANT WISEINDIVIDUAL ONLYEXTRA SHEET
✓
Report E
Registration — Actual Amount Range (Min / Max), Model & Variant wise · By Dealer: In House · Amt > ₹10,000
For Registration actual amount column, computes Min, Max, Range, Mean and Count by Model and by Model Variant. Filtered to rows where Registration Type = "By Dealer: In House" and amount > ₹10,000 (BH / Bharat / Self: By Customer rows are excluded; tiny stub entries below ₹10k are excluded). Amount column auto-detected from: "Registration Type - Actual Amount", "Registration - Actual Amount", "RTO - Actual Amount", "Registration Charges - Actual Amount".
REGISTRATIONMODEL WISEVARIANT WISEBY DEALER: IN HOUSE> ₹10K
✓
Report F
Insurance Amount Range (Min / Max), Model & Variant wise · In-House Insurance only
For column "Insurance Amount", computes Min, Max, Range, Mean and Count grouped by Model and by Model Variant. Filtered to rows where Insurance Type is "Inhouse" / "In House" / "In-House" (Self / external policies excluded — those don't reflect dealer-controlled premiums). Auto-detected amount aliases: "Insurance Premium", "Policy Amount", "Insurance - Actual Amount". Excludes blank and zero values. Sorted by Range (desc).
INSURANCEMODEL WISEVARIANT WISEIN-HOUSE ONLYEXTRA SHEET

Deemed DSA

Working A
Tool Receipts vs Bank Statement Reconciliation
Match every payment entry in the tool receipt tracker against actual bank credit entries. Flag: receipts in tool not found in bank · bank credits not in tool · amount mismatch (>₹100) · date mismatch · mode mismatch (Cash/NEFT/UPI/Cheque/DD/Finance/DO). Output: matched rows + unmatched rows with variance reason.

Working C
Payment Verification — Mode-wise Match to Deal Amount
For each booking: sum all payment receipts mode-wise (Cash + Cheque + NEFT/RTGS + UPI + DD + Finance Disbursement + DO Payment). Compare total against Standard Deal Amount and Actual Deal Amount. ✓
Working 01
Exchange Car — Agreed Value vs Actual Sale Price
Compare the value agreed with customer at time of exchange vs the price at which the car was actually sold. Calculate gain/loss per vehicle. Flag all cases where actual sale price differs from agreed value. Summary by dealership and model.
VALUE RECONVARIANCE
✓
Working 02
Exchange Cars Pending Sale — Beyond 90 Days
List all exchange vehicles still unsold as of audit date. Calculate days held since purchase. Flag cars held beyond 90 days. Show purchase value locked, ageing slab (0–30, 31–60, 61–90, 90+ days), dealership-wise count and value at risk.
90 DAY RULEAGEINGVALUE AT RISK
✓
Working 03
Exchange Car Sold at a Loss
Identify all exchange cars where sale price is less than purchase price. Calculate loss per vehicle. Flag potential misuse — intentional undervaluation. Show total loss booked by dealership. Cross-check against any refurbishment costs if provided.
LOSS FLAGP&L IMPACT
✓
Working 04
Fake Trade-In Discount Detection
Cross-reference trade-in discount given in tool data (Master File 2) against the exchange vehicle register. Flag cases where exchange discount was passed but: no exchange vehicle is registered · vehicle registered at zero value · discount amount exceeds reasonable vehicle value. Output: confirmed fake trade-in cases with deal amount impact.
FAKE DETECTIONCROSS-CHECKFINANCIAL RISK
